subject: Shiny download report problem running examples locally from R studio

messages.author: 0617777d7b4a6cbb
messages.subject: Shiny download report problem running examples locally from R studio
parts:
I posted this question on stack over flow, but I thought I would try here as well.  Thank you for your time.

I want to create a shiny app that lets me download reports. As such I have found two examples by Yihui. Example 1, Example 2.

I can run the gist (example 1) by rungist() and it works fine. I am able to download the example document. When I copy the code and run the app from R Studio I receive the following error when I try to download the document:

Running 'texi2dvi' on 'input.tex' failed. Messages: /usr/bin/texi2dvi: pdflatex exited with bad status, quitting. /usr/bin/texi2dvi: see input.log for errors.

I have researched this error and came upon this link and it seems to be the same problem, although it remains unresolved.

I have gone through the suggestions and I believe it has something to do with my PATH, although this is a subject I am unfamiliar with and trying to understand. Typing the command $PATH into terminal I receive the following:

-bash:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/X11/bin:/usr/local/git/bin:/usr/texbin: No such file or directory

I also opened the app in my browser. I received the following different error when trying to download the document from the browser:

.onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'tcltk', details: call: system2("otool", c("-L", shQuote(DLL)), stdout = TRUE) error: error in running command

I continue to receive this error when I try to run the app in R Studio and X11 now opens.

I receive the same error when I try to load the package tcltk package.

The example 2 I am able to run and download a document on my machine, but it is not compiled like when I download it from the same app running on the shiny gallery here.

My document looks like

Here is my regression model: options(digits = 4) fit <- lm(regFormula(), data = mtcars) b <- coef(fit) summary(fit) The fitting result is mpg = rb[1] + rb[2]rinputx $. Below is a scatter plot with the regression line. par(mar = c(4, 4, 1, 1)) plot(regFormula(), data = mtcars, pch = 19, col = ‘gray’) abline(fit, col = ‘red’, lwd = 2)

I am not sure if these problems are linked or separate.

I am hesitant to make changes to my PATH because it is unfamiliar to me, but if this is what I need to focus on please let me know. I appreciate any help and direction offered.
